item.title: Letter: Freedom of religion and freedom from religion — both are important in America
item.description: The current federal administration in America was elected by and is driven by a particular interpretation of what Jesus taught his disciples. Today, the Christian church, whether fundamentalist or liberal, does not teach that reincarnation is a reality.

item.title: Guest column: What makes a workplace a ‘Best Place to Work?’
item.description: What makes a workplace truly great? For most of us, it goes well beyond a paycheck. It’s about feeling valued, supported and confident that the work we do matters. It’s knowing there’s room to grow, that wellbeing is more than a buzzword, and that leadership is invested in people, not just outcomes.

item.title: Live United: Curious how your workplace can help others in community?
item.description: I’m writing this in the silence of my living room. Everyone’s asleep, even the puppy. For me, I need a little decompression time because it’s been a whiplash of a day. The thing about United Way is that we have a broad range of focuses.

item.title: April Jeppson: You have the power to take control back
item.description: I’ve heard a lot of buzz around elections lately. Waiting to cast your vote in November is like waiting until New Year’s to start a healthy habit. You don’t have to wait. There are things you can do right now.

item.description: February is I Love to Read Month, and as promoters of the written word, we applaud the people and organizations throughout the community who encourage children and adults to read.
